spanish: Y se llenaron siete días después de herir Jehová al Yeor.
grammarChanges: se llenó -> se llenaron: made the verb agree in number with siete días so días is unambiguously the subject, not a trailing time adverb
readerNote: Singular construct שִׁבְעַת forces 3ms agreement in Hebrew, but Spanish needs plural agreement with días to keep siete días as the subject of the filling, so se llenaron was chosen over se llenó.
